purpose: personal account of Alexey building a Telegram-based writing assistant for organizing background work into article drafts

required_facts.fact: Alexey wanted to share the early thinking, experiments, and workflows normally hidden behind finished public work.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 3-7: the background-work motivation is stated.

required_facts.fact: The initial workflow used a Telegram chat as a brain dump for ideas that helped create the first newsletter editions.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 18: the initial chat and newsletter role are described.

required_facts.fact: The chat accumulated voice notes, files, screenshots, partial thoughts, corrections, and follow-ups that were difficult to categorize.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 23-26: the unstructured backlog and switching friction are described.

required_facts.fact: Turning the stream into structured material required manual rereading, sorting, and stitching and was slow and mentally expensive.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 26-30: manual processing cost is stated.

required_facts.fact: ChatGPT was used to refine the workflow and save the conversation as summary.md, which became the system specification.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 34-41: specification creation and ChatGPT's role are described.

required_facts.fact: Claude Code followed the specification to build the first working version, a Telegram bot connected to a GitHub repository.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 46-50: implementation, repository, and testing are described.

required_facts.fact: The /process command batches accumulated material, assigns items to existing or new articles, and updates articles incrementally.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 63-70: capture and processing workflow are specified.

required_facts.fact: Each processing run creates a GitHub commit with a change explanation and sends the commit link back to Telegram.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 72-77: versioning and feedback behavior are described.

required_facts.fact: The /check-tasks command processes bug reports and feature suggestions and can update the prompt or code before committing changes.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 79-84: configuration update flow is stated.

required_facts.fact: The assistant uses Whisper via Groq, Groq Vision, translation into English, link summarization, and Git-based diffs as focused capabilities.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 95-117: transcription, image, multilingual, link, and Git orchestration capabilities are described.

author_attribution: Attribute the assistant, workflow, and implementation choices to Alexey; preserve the distinction between capturing background work and publishing reviewed articles.
